# cmd/dist names the port of a test that runs on the host with -target.
# The result is cached, and the target is part of the test ID.

go test ./t -args -target=wasip1/wasm
stdout '^ok\s+m/t\s+[0-9.]+s$'
go test ./t -args -target=wasip1/wasm
stdout '^ok\s+m/t\s+\(cached\)'
go test ./t -args -target=js/wasm
! stdout '\(cached\)'

# Another argument that is not a test flag still turns caching off.
go test ./t -args -target=js/wasm -other
! stdout '\(cached\)'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.20
-- t/t_test.go --
package t

import (
	"flag"
	"testing"
)

var target = flag.String("target", "", "the port")
var other = flag.Bool("other", false, "unused")

func TestTarget(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log(*target, *other)
}
